row.evidence: Postman's pricing comparison marks User provisioning (SCIM) available only on Enterprise (Contact sales for pricing), and the Team-plan Simple Security SSO add-on states "SCIM provisioning not included."
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Price change since June: Enterprise is now 'Contact sales for pricing' (June's $49/u/mo is no longer on the page), so scim_price_per_user_mo and the multiplier are null. Team $19/u/mo and Solo $9/mo unchanged. SSO moved below Enterprise: Team can buy the Simple Security add-on at $6/user/month (org-wide, all licensed users; JIT always on; SCIM not included), so sso_price = $19 + $6. SCIM requires SSO first and a SCIM API key from an Admin or Super Admin. Deactivation removes the user from the team and blocks sign-in but keeps the account and data; no SCIM user DELETE is documented. Native apps for Okta (OIN, SCIM incl. Group Push), Entra gallery and OneLogin; generic SCIM 2.0 API at api.postman.com/scim/v2 (guides use api.getpostman.com/scim/v2). Audit logs and audit-log API are Enterprise.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: SAML SSO via the Simple Security add-on, $6 per user/month; 1 million API calls/month.

auth.token_source: Team settings > Authentication > SCIM Provisioning > Generate SCIM API Key (Admin or Super Admin; can be owned by a service account)

deprovision.data_retained: Account and its data are kept; the user is removed from the team and blocked from signing in.

pagination.notes: startIndex/count, default count 100; maximum not stated.

custom.how: Only name updates are pushed from the IdP; no custom attributes documented.

roles.how: Group-to-role mapping: assign team roles to a Postman user group, then add users to it via SCIM; new users default to Developer.

limitations.text: No group push from Postman to the IdP, no password sync, and no attribute updates other than name.
A SCIM key owned by an Admin cannot de-provision a Super Admin, and email changes need a Super Admin-owned key.
Help article says only one SSO method may be configured to generate a SCIM key; the overview says multiple SSO needs Postman support.

scim.notes: IdP guides give https://api.getpostman.com/scim/v2 (EU: https://api.eu.postman.com/scim/v2); the API reference uses https://api.postman.com/scim/v2.

endpoints.purpose: Get all teams in the organization
Add or remove member roles for users, groups, teams, organizations
Remove users or organizations from the team

rate_limits.text: 300 requests per minute per key; monthly call quota by plan (10,000 Free, 100,000 Solo, 1 million Team, 10 million Enterprise).

limitations.text: user_api_plan 'Team' is inferred: the Postman API is on every plan, but team-user and team-member endpoints only apply to multi-user teams.

okta.notes: OIN markup: SAML, SCIM; Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push. Last updated May 14, 2024.

google.notes: Google Workspace listed as an SSO IdP; no Google provisioning guide.

onelogin.notes: Cited from Postman's own OneLogin guide.

IdP setup guides give the SCIM base URL as https://api.getpostman.com/scim/v2, the API reference as https://api.postman.com/scim/v2.
